title: This Man Had the Hiccups for 68 Years 😮 #shorts
description:
Iowa farmer Charles Osborne holds the Guinness World Record for the longest attack of hiccups: from 1922 to 1990, a full 68 years. It started while he was handling a hog, ran at about 20 to 40 hiccups per minute, and added up to an estimated 430 million hiccups. He still married twice and had eight children – and the hiccups stopped on their own about a year before he died in 1991.

Sources: Guinness World Records, Smithsonian Magazine, Wikipedia, IFLScience, ScienceAlert

scenes.text: One man had the hiccups for sixty-eight years. Without stopping.
scenes.headline:
68 YEARS
OF HICCUPS

scenes.text: His name was Charles Osborne, a farmer from Iowa. In 1922, he was handling a heavy hog when it suddenly started.
The hiccups didn't stop until 1990. That's sixty-eight years, a Guinness World Record.
He hiccuped about twenty to forty times every single minute.
In total, that's an estimated four hundred and thirty million hiccups!
scenes.label: HICCUPS

scenes.text: And he still lived a normal life. He got married twice and had eight children.
scenes.label: CHILDREN

scenes.text: Doctors never found a cure. Then, about a year before he died, the hiccups just stopped on their own.
So next time you get the hiccups for five minutes, be thankful!
